Playbooks.note: Product name. No Italian locale file exists for the Playbooks plugin; all entries below are grounded in core-product Italian conventions and standard Italian software terminology.

playbook.note: Kept in English, as is customary in Italian business/ops software; masculine, invariable: 'il playbook', 'i playbook'.

run.note: Noun (a run of a playbook): 'esecuzione' (feminine). Verb (to run a playbook): 'eseguire' — button 'Esegui playbook'. Keep the noun/verb distinction.

checklist.note: Kept in English, common in Italian software; feminine, invariable: 'la checklist', 'le checklist'. Alternative 'lista di controllo' if a fully Italian form is preferred.

task.note: Standard Italian for task (Microsoft convention); feminine, invariable in plural: 'le attività'.

owner.note: Consistent with core-product usage ('proprietario' for bot owner). 'Run owner' = 'proprietario dell'esecuzione'. Alternative 'responsabile' conveys accountability but breaks consistency.

follower.note: Kept in English per Italian social-software convention; masculine, invariable. Verb pair: Follow = 'Segui', Unfollow = 'Non seguire più' (consistent with core glossary).

trigger.note: Kept in English, common in Italian automation tools; masculine, invariable. Alternative 'attivazione'. Related: trigger word = 'parola di attivazione' in the core glossary.

action.note: Feminine; 'Run Actions' = 'Azioni dell'esecuzione', 'Channel Actions' = 'Azioni del canale'.

overdue.note: 'Update overdue' = 'Aggiornamento in ritardo'; also 'scaduto' for a passed due date on tasks.

due date.note: Feminine. 'No due date' = 'Nessuna scadenza'; 'Due' = 'Scadenza'. Fuller form 'data di scadenza' where space allows.

template.note: Standard Italian UI term; 'Retrospective template' = 'Modello di retrospettiva'.

timeline.note: 'View Timeline' = 'Visualizza cronologia'. Alternative 'sequenza temporale' (Microsoft) is longer; prefer 'cronologia'.

stakeholder.note: Kept in English, standard in Italian business language; masculine, invariable.

invitation.note: Consistent with core glossary; 'Invite participants' = 'Invita i partecipanti'.

run channel.note: 'Create a run channel' = 'Crea un canale per l'esecuzione'; channel = 'canale' per core glossary.

attribute.note: Consistent with core glossary; 'Property Fields' alias = 'campi proprietà'.

section.note: Feminine; 'Add a section' = 'Aggiungi una sezione', 'Section name' = 'Nome della sezione'.

run summary.note: 'Add a run summary' = 'Aggiungi un riepilogo dell'esecuzione'; 'riepilogo' consistent with recap/meeting summary in the other glossaries.
